title: On canonical triangulations of once-punctured torus bundles and two-bridge link complements
note: Geom. Topol. 10(3) (2006), 1239-1284 (with an appendix by David Futer); arXiv:math/0406242v4. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.2140/gt.2006.10.1239) and arXiv e-print source (2026-11-28). Establishes geometricity and canonical status of the layered ideal triangulations of hyperbolic once-punctured torus bundles from RL monodromy words (Theorem 1.1) and, in David Futer's Appendix B (Sections 9-10), of two-bridge link complements via pillowcase folding.
